logp.method_description: The lipophilicity (log Po/w values) of the complexes was measured by using the shake-flask method. An aliquot of stock solution of the complex in aqueous NaCl solution (0.9%, w/v, saturated with n-octanol) was added to an equal volume of n-octanol (saturated with aqueous NaCl solution). The mixture was shaken vigorously for 4 h and then centrifuged at 40 rpm for 30 min for phase separation. The two immiscible layers were carefully isolated and the concentration of the complex in the aqueous layer was determined by ICP-MS. Log Po/w is defined as the logarithmic ratio of the concentration of the complex in n-octanol (saturated with NaCl) to that in an aqueous solution of NaCl (0.9%, w/v, saturated with n-octanol).
